levelHelp.low: One confirmed refusal — ship as usual, maybe call first.
levelHelp.medium: Refused more than once — call to confirm before shipping.
levelHelp.high: Refuses often — ask for a deposit or online payment.
levelHelp.blocked: Checkout does not offer cash on delivery to this number.

reason.no_show: Never picked it up at the branch

codrisk.counts: {n} confirmed refusal · {shops} shop | {n} confirmed refusals · {shops} shops
codrisk.disabled: The COD risk module is switched off on this server.

seller.title: COD risk
seller.intro: Report customers who don't take their cash-on-delivery parcel. An admin checks each report and decides the customer's risk level, which every shop sees before shipping. Reports are recorded on a tamper-proof ledger.
seller.unshippedIntro: COD orders you haven't handed to the courier yet. Call customers with a risk level before you ship.
seller.unshippedEmpty: No COD orders waiting to ship.
seller.refusedIntro: COD parcels that came back (marked returned in the COD page). You can report them for {days} days.
seller.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this report? The admin won't review it.
seller.filed: Report sent — an admin will review it.
seller.modalIntro: Tell the admin what happened. Be factual: the customer can ask for a review, and false reports are dismissed.
seller.notePh: e.g. The customer answered the HAL courier and said they no longer want it.
seller.checkIntro: Look up a customer before accepting a COD order by phone or chat. You see the level and how many shops confirmed a refusal — never other shops' details.

admin.title: COD risk
admin.subtitle: Review sellers' reports of refused COD parcels and decide each customer's risk level.

customer.suggestedHelp: Based on confirmed reports. The decision is yours.
customer.levelNotePh: e.g. Refused 3 parcels at 2 shops in September
customer.expiresNever: Leave empty to keep until changed
customer.saved: Level saved and recorded on the ledger.
customer.decisionNotePh: Required to dismiss or to change a decision
customer.ledgerHelp: Every event about this customer. The ledger stores only keys and hashes — no names or phone numbers.

chain.driverOff: Off — the ledger is verified locally only. Set COD_RISK_ANCHOR=webhook to publish to a chain.
chain.hashBad: Block hash does NOT match its content
chain.rootOk: Merkle path leads to the anchored root
chain.rootBad: Merkle path does NOT lead to the anchored root
chain.proofHelp: Anyone can verify this block: hash its content, follow the Merkle path, and compare with the root in transaction {tx}.
